facts.fact: 新年前夜全城歇业；连街边小贩和轿夫也收摊，盼着长假。
facts.anchor: Everything closed down the night before the new year. Even the street vendors and sedan-chair drivers packed up, looking forward to the long holiday.

facts.fact: 剑玲与晶玲蹲下给父母和祖父上香，在门外烧纸钱，听着别街驱邪的爆竹声。
facts.anchor: Kiamling and Jingling squatted down to light joss sticks for their parents and grandfather. They burnt hell notes outside, listening to the popping of firecrackers from other streets to ward away evil spirits.

facts.fact: 爆竹更近地炸成一串；这声音是为驱走「年兽」——岁末交替时出来吃人畜的饿兽。
facts.anchor: More firecrackers popped, closer this time, in a rattling tail. The noise warded off the nin sau, the hungry beast that came out during the turn of the year to feed on people and livestock.

facts.fact: 一条蛇从海（Hoi）袖里滑出、缠上他手指；剑玲想立刻掷镖钉穿蛇头的冲动，比以往消退得更快。
facts.anchor: A snake slid out of Hoi’s sleeve and twisted round his fingers. The urge to exorcise it immediately – fling down a dart and skewer its diamond head – passed quicker than previously.

facts.fact: 他们「宽宏地」把发言权给吴律师（Barrister Ng），让他谈香港文化遗产以及他申请拨款开医院的呈请。
facts.anchor: Magnanimously, they had given Barrister Ng the floor to talk about Hong Kong’s cultural heritage and his petition for funds to open a hospital.

facts.fact: 春芽阁里姚妈把所有的流浪者都聚齐了；活人的座位充足，死者的座位还多出一倍有余。
facts.anchor: Inside the Pavilion of Spring Buds, Madam Yau had gathered all the waifs and strays. There were seats aplenty for the living, and more than double the quantity for the dead.

facts.fact: 但愿这「尾」落在明年而非几小时后——那时若剑玲关不上门户，异界的变异怪物便会涌入。
facts.anchor: Hopefully that end was in another year’s time, not in a few hours, when Kiamling failed to close the portal and mutated monsters from the otherworld came streaming through.

facts.fact: 晶玲往姐姐碗里夹了一大块鱼，又凑近身说话，不让话传到两人之外。
facts.anchor: Jingling had put a generous portion of fish into her sister’s bowl. She leant in so that her words did not carry beyond the two of them.

facts.fact: 马上那人穿厚重欧式大衣，却完全没有头；凄厉的尖叫随他远去，街道笼上雾。
facts.anchor: The man mounted atop it was wearing a heavy European overcoat and entirely missing his head. A haunting scream trailed after him as the streets fogged over.

facts.fact: 那东西冲他们怪笑，随即扑咬剑玲的手；她及时摔上了窗板。
facts.anchor: It cackled at them, then lunged to bite Kiamling’s hand. She slammed the shutter closed just in time.

facts.fact: 不会有什么褒奖、雕像或以他们命名的街道；但亲友与后代将因今夜之举而兴旺。
facts.anchor: There will be no accolades, no statues or streets named after us, I’m afraid. But our families, our friends, our descendants will thrive because of our actions here.

facts.fact: 梁木匠造过许多人的家、连文武庙也是他建的；他困在新警署里，正在墙中变成怪物。
facts.anchor: You all know Carpenter Leung? He built many of our homes, even Man Mo temple. He is trapped in there, turning into a monster within the walls.

facts.fact: 他身周是一圈宽约一掌的盐和米；房里不挂水彩画和书法，门、墙、窗上贴着几十张符。
facts.anchor: Around him was a circle of salt and rice, a handspan wide. And in lieu of watercolour paintings and calligraphy, dozens of fu talisman on every door, wall and window.

facts.fact: 那英国人猛地缩开，从乱发下警惕地瞪她；他四肢着地咆哮，瞳孔血红、没有一丝眼白。
facts.anchor: The Englishman jerked away, glaring at her warily from beneath lank hair. He rose onto all fours and snarled. His pupils liquid red, not a hint of white left in them.

facts.fact: 直到脚踩进那厚厚一圈盐米，她才清醒过来，退了回去。
facts.anchor: It was only when her foot crunched into the thick strip of salt and rice that she regained her senses. She moved back.

facts.fact: 她会跟妖精重新谈条件，必要时用铁棒敲它们的头；她要替他找回记忆。
facts.anchor: I’ll renegotiate with the fae; I’ll beat them about the head with an iron club if I have to. We’ll get your memories back, Archie.

facts.fact: 他的粤语无懈可击，满脸都是饥色；目光像绞索套住她，而她甘愿收紧。
facts.anchor: His Cantonese was flawless. The hunger apparent in every aspect of his face. His eyes held hers like a noose, and she willingly tightened it around her neck.

facts.fact: 两人掌心相对悬着，相隔不过几寸，那一刻却像隔着万里长城。
facts.anchor: Their hands hovered, palms flat towards each other. A few inches lay between them, but in that moment it could have been the ten-thousand-li wall.
